summary: Select native OSM island, islet and archipelago features and all coastline polygons; retain exact name locale suffixes, tags and geometry. Use native OSM IDs and geometry-content coastline IDs, rejecting conflicting duplicate identities.

en.description: Select native OSM island, islet and archipelago features and all coastline polygons; retain exact name locale suffixes, tags and geometry. Use native OSM IDs and geometry-content coastline IDs, rejecting conflicting duplicate identities.

zh-hant.description: 選取原生 OSM 島嶼、小島、群島要素及所有海岸線多邊形；保留名稱的確切語言後綴、標籤及幾何。使用原生 OSM 識別碼及海岸線幾何內容識別碼，拒絕有衝突的重複識別碼。

zh-hans.description: 选取原生 OSM 岛屿、小岛、群岛要素及所有海岸线多边形；保留名称的确切语言后缀、标签及几何。使用原生 OSM 识别码及海岸线几何内容识别码，拒绝有冲突的重复识别码。
